question: Will Bitcoin close at or above $120,000 on December 31, 2026?
description: This market resolves based on the BTC/USD closing price on Coinbase at 23:59:59 UTC on December 31, 2026.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if the Coinbase BTC-USD last traded price at 23:59:59 UTC on 2026-12-31 is greater than or equal to $120,000.00. Resolves NO otherwise.
